presets.name: Abyss Anchor 465
presets.styleRef: Hans Zimmer / Dune-style sub drone + impact bed
presets.sonicGoal: A massive, felt-not-heard sub floor with a defined top so booms punch through — maximum low-end POWER without the boomy mud, the bedrock under a whole cue.

presets.name: Inception BRAAAM 465
presets.styleRef: Zimmer-style Inception BRAAAM / epic trailer horn
presets.sonicGoal: A mega-powerful horn-like blast with authority, long sustain and controlled rasp — power and edge without ear-splitting harshness.

presets.name: Stratosphere Riser 465
presets.sonicGoal: Rising anticipation that stays clear of the low end and blooms open in air at the peak, then hands off to a drop/impact.

presets.name: The Beast — Dread Drone 465
presets.styleRef: Johann Johannsson 'The Beast' (Sicario) / Rezz-style droning-mid dissonance
presets.sonicGoal: An unstable, dread-building sustained drone — scooped 'big' but menacing, with a metallic ring auto-tamed and a one-band dark/bright tension morph.

presets.name: Vantablack Pad 465
presets.styleRef: BT / Vangelis-style wide cinematic pad — 'epic wide/deep' spectral balance
presets.sonicGoal: A huge, deep, airy, silky pad with the full smile curve — low-end power + scooped mud + high-end air — that evolves slowly under a scene.

presets.name: Void Downer / Whoosh 465
presets.styleRef: Cinematic downer / whoosh transition (the plane-plummet fall into a drop)
presets.sonicGoal: A descending, evaporating fall that darkens as it drops and blooms a sub on landing — a transition that sucks energy downward into an impact.

presets.name: BRAAAM Tamer / De-Fizz Bank
presets.styleRef: Dynamic de-harsh + resonance suppression (pro dynamic-EQ practice, SonicScoop / iZotope)
presets.sonicGoal: A drop-on bank for ANY buzzy/metallic OsciSynth-FM patch that auto-tames the harsh presence rasp, the sibilant fizz and the worst ringing partial — transparent when the sound behaves, clamping only on peaks.

presets.name: Cinematic Smile Bus
presets.sonicGoal: A drop-on bank that instantly makes ANY OsciSynth patch sound bigger and more epic — sub weight, scooped mud, airy top — the fastest 'cinematic-ize' move.

presets.name: Cathedral Drift
presets.styleRef: Stars of the Lid / Brian Eno slow evolving drone
presets.sonicGoal: A vast, warm, cathedral-sized pad that morphs almost imperceptibly — the metallic edge of the oscilloscope tone dissolved into a soft, airy wash.

presets.name: Glass Shimmer Pad
presets.sonicGoal: A bright, glassy, moving pad that sparkles up top while staying clear of the sub — leaves room for a kick, with harshness dynamically tamed so the shimmer never fatigues.

presets.name: Hypnotic Wasp Mid
presets.sonicGoal: A hypnotic, buzzing droning mid that sits in the middle of a track and never fatigues — the wasp-buzz character kept but its harsh peaks dynamically leashed so it can drone for bars.

presets.name: Sub Monolith
presets.sonicGoal: A deep, menacing, near-black sub-drone — heavy low weight, low-mid mud kept in check dynamically, top end almost entirely removed for dread.

presets.name: Tape Ghost
presets.sonicGoal: A nostalgic, band-limited, slightly-wobbling pad that sounds like it was bounced to a worn cassette — rolled-off highs, warm mids, faint noise.

presets.name: Breathing Air
presets.sonicGoal: Adds slow, level-linked movement and air to any static pad — the top end blooms as the drone falls quiet and settles back as it swells, so nothing ever sits perfectly still.

presets.name: Glass Lead Presence 465
presets.styleRef: Melodic / future-bass bright lead (production-expert tilt approach)
presets.sonicGoal: A shimmering, cutting lead that stays present and glassy without turning brittle or harsh.

presets.name: Sub Anchor 465
presets.styleRef: Festival house / techno mono sub (mixanalog mono-low-end)
presets.sonicGoal: A tight, mono, phase-coherent sub/bass foundation from the oscilloscope — weight without wander or fizz.

presets.name: Talking Growl 465
presets.styleRef: Neuro / dubstep vocal growl (Rezz / Zomboy / Skrillex-adjacent; edm.com beefy-growls)
presets.sonicGoal: An aggressive mid-range bass that 'talks' — vowel-morphing, metallic, wobbling with the FM LFO.

presets.name: Foundation Cleanup 465
presets.styleRef: Universal EDM mix hygiene (edmprod / Sage Audio EQ methodology)
presets.sonicGoal: The default starting-grid that drops onto ANY OsciSynth patch: reclaims headroom, de-muds, and leashes the metallic top without imposing a tone.

presets.name: Pluck Pocket 465
presets.sonicGoal: Carves any 465 pluck to sit in its own slot — above the bass, below the vocal — with a crisp transient.

presets.name: Riser & Noise-FX Shaper 465
presets.styleRef: Build-up white-noise / attractor sweep FX (unison risers guide)
presets.sonicGoal: Shapes a riser or noise-FX (lorenz + high JITTER) so it 'opens up' as it builds and never ear-fatigues at the peak.

presets.name: Metal Larynx Growl
presets.styleRef: Skrillex brostep tearout growl (aggressive FM8-through-Ohmicide lineage)
presets.sonicGoal: A violent, metallic, chaotic growl - max aggression in the mids, scooped and biting, with the fixed metallic ring leashed so it stays musical.

presets.name: Robot Chatter Screech Lead
presets.styleRef: Skrillex metallic robotic vocal-formant lead / screech ('nasty EE' robot voice)
presets.sonicGoal: A higher-register metallic screech-lead with a nasal 'EE/robot' formant character and fast chatter - sits above the growl as a talking topline.

presets.name: Talking Reese Preacher
presets.styleRef: Skrillex / Kill The Noise talking-vowel reese bass ('Scary Monsters', 'Kyoto' lineage)
presets.sonicGoal: A low, moving reese-style drone that morphs through vowels ('oo->ah->ee') like a preaching robot voice, thick on the bottom and spitting a bright bite up top.

presets.name: Brostep Scoop + Bite Bank
presets.styleRef: Generic Skrillex/brostep mid contour - scooped low-mids + 1-3 kHz bite + de-harsh
presets.sonicGoal: Instantly give any bass the brostep frequency shape: hollowed low-mids, a spiky presence bite, harshness tamed dynamically, and a softened top.

presets.name: Sub-Split Low-End Glue Bank
presets.styleRef: Skrillex layering rule - clean mono sub under distorted mids
presets.sonicGoal: Manage the low end of a layered bass so a distorted growl and a clean sub coexist: steep cut, controlled sub weight, and a dynamic duck so the sub gets out of the growl's way.

presets.name: Vowel-Morph Formant Bank
presets.styleRef: Skrillex FM8 TalkWah / vowel-filter talking bass, as a drop-on EQ
presets.sonicGoal: Turn ANY OsciSynth generator (or any layered sound) into a talking bass by stamping a movable vowel formant mask onto it. Ships tuned to 'AH' with A/E/I/O/U snapshots.

presets.name: Broken Investigation
presets.styleRef: Moody Good — This Is The Investigation textural/glitch EP
presets.sonicGoal: An evolving, chaotic, glitchy textural drone — unstable and cinematic rather than a clean note; dark, degraded, broken.

presets.name: Grime Reese Mangler
presets.styleRef: Moody Good / 16bit — ragged grime-dubstep reese mid-bass
presets.sonicGoal: A detuned, twisting, growling reese-style mid-bass with heavy movement and bite that cuts a busy 140/grime mix.

presets.name: Sludgehammer 465
presets.styleRef: Moody Good — heavy half-time distorted bass (Moody Good LP era)
presets.sonicGoal: A huge, woozy, half-time distorted bass drone: massive clean sub under a snarling, over-folded, controlled-fizz mid.

presets.name: DIRT — Weight & De-Harsh
presets.styleRef: Moody Good — universal grit-shaping bus (drop on ANY bass patch)
presets.sonicGoal: The house 'make it dirty but musical' bank: anchor the sub, add dynamic low-mid weight, tame fold fizz, push the growl — the load-bearing Moody Good EQ moves with zero synth changes.

presets.name: LO-FI Broken Bus
presets.styleRef: Moody Good — degraded / textural lo-fi (telephone/tape crush)
presets.sonicGoal: Band-limited, crushed, broken texture for any sound — the This Is The Investigation degraded aesthetic as a droppable bank.

presets.name: METAL — Resonance Cleanup
presets.sonicGoal: Kill the stuck ringing tones from inharmonic xHarm/yHarm/zHarm ratios and lorenz/mobius drones while keeping all the grit — the essential companion bank for any heavily-folded geometric patch.

presets.name: Glass Sub 465
presets.styleRef: Flume deep CLEAN pitch-following sub ('moving floor')
presets.sonicGoal: A deep, round, mono-tight sub with zero mud that ducks cleanly around the kick and can pitch-follow the chords.

presets.name: Lantern Chords 465
presets.styleRef: Flume / Cashmere Cat lush wide detuned supersaw chord stack
presets.sonicGoal: A big, breathing, hi-fi future-bass chord stack: wide and shimmering up top, tight and clean below, with the metallic scope edge tamed dynamically so it stays glossy on peaks.

presets.name: Ribbon Bend Lead
presets.sonicGoal: A vocal-like, pitch-gliding lead with bite that cuts through the drop but never gets harsh, sitting cleanly above the bass.

presets.name: Vowel Chop Engine
presets.styleRef: Flume / Hi This Is Flume granular vocal-chop texture
presets.sonicGoal: A morphing, formant-vowel, granular-grit chop-lead that reads like a mangled processed vocal, with sibilant fizz controlled and air added.

presets.name: Chord-Stack Dynamic Tamer + Width
presets.styleRef: Flume dense-drop chord-stack control + wide-top feel
presets.sonicGoal: Layer onto any lush/detuned stack to keep it glossy and wide under heavy layering: catches low-mid buildup and every harsh/sibilant peak, then lifts clarity and air for width feel.

presets.name: Flume Air & Clean-Sub Bus
presets.sonicGoal: A drop-on EQ bank that instantly gives any sound the Flume balance: DC-guarded clean sub, ducked low end, controlled mud, tamed metallic edge, and hi-fi air.

presets.name: Locrian Pendulum Bass
presets.styleRef: REZZ - 'Suffer in Silence' (B Locrian, 97 BPM) mid-tempo swing
presets.sonicGoal: A slower, more melodic REZZ bass that swings like a pendulum — designed to be played as a syncopated Locrian bassline (b2/b5) rather than a single held drone.

presets.name: Mangled Metal Helix (combined-patch)
presets.styleRef: REZZ industrial / 'CAN YOU SEE ME?' distorted, downsampled grit (Saturn 2 + Redux)
presets.sonicGoal: The harshest, most industrial REZZ variant — a distorted, bit-crushed metallic drone for drops and horror-film tension, aggressively de-harshed so it stays controlled.

presets.name: Witching Hour Drone
presets.styleRef: REZZ - 'Witching Hour' / 'Edge' style droning wub mid-bass
presets.sonicGoal: A dark, hypnotic mid-tempo drone whose resonant 'wub' formant swings slowly around 300-1kHz over a tight, controlled sub — the flagship REZZ combined patch.

presets.name: Hypnotic Vowel Wub (EQ bank)
presets.sonicGoal: Drop the REZZ moving-resonant vowel character onto ANY existing drone, bass, or pad so it starts to 'talk' and breathe without touching the source synth.

presets.name: Industrial Sub Clamp (EQ bank)
presets.styleRef: REZZ tight, controlled, mono low-end discipline
presets.sonicGoal: A drop-on chain that makes any bass low-end REZZ-tight: clean, mono-solid, punchy, and clamped so sustained notes never boom or wash — pure low-end control, no tone-shaping up top.

presets.name: Aurora Pad Bed
presets.styleRef: Spacey wide atmospheric melodic-dubstep pad (Seven Lions-style cinematic wall)
presets.sonicGoal: Lush, wide, emotional pad/atmosphere bed with airy top and no low-mid clutter — the euphoric backdrop under the drop.

presets.name: Glassfall Sub
presets.styleRef: LEVITY / deep-dubstep pristine mono sub foundation
presets.sonicGoal: Rock-solid, buzz-free, mono deep sub — the clean weight the whole drop rides on.

presets.name: Reese Cathedral
presets.styleRef: Modern melodic-dubstep / DnB-lineage designed reese mid-bass (UKF-era deep dubstep)
presets.sonicGoal: Wide, pulsating, emotional reese that growls but never screeches — the melodic drop's backbone.

presets.name: Vowel Engine Growl
presets.sonicGoal: A talking, vowel-morphing growl that reads as a voice — aggressive but de-harshed and de-essed so it stays refined.

presets.name: Air & Sheen Polish
presets.styleRef: LEVITY polished high-end / master + lead/pad sheen
presets.sonicGoal: Layerable 'expensive top-end' bank for leads, pads, vocals or master — adds air and brightness while dynamically catching only the harsh spikes.

presets.name: Clean Sub Isolator
presets.styleRef: Deep-dubstep clean sub-shelf, droppable onto any bass
presets.sonicGoal: Instantly fence and level ANY bass layer into a clean, mono, controlled sub without touching the synth patch — the 'clean sub shelf' archetype as a bank.

presets.name: Drop Tamer
presets.sonicGoal: Drop onto any dense drop or heavy bass bus to keep it LOUD but polished — clamps harsh/resonant/splash peaks dynamically without dulling the sound between hits.

presets.name: Lorenz Ghost-Notch
presets.sonicGoal: A chaotic wandering drone whose random screaming resonances are auto-suppressed as they MOVE across the spectrum — the poster child for spectral dynamics on this synth.

presets.name: Metallic Bloom Character
presets.styleRef: Jean-Michel Jarre metallic bell-pad / modern superformula lead
presets.sonicGoal: A big, shiny, characterful metallic pad that bites and sparkles but never crosses into harsh.

presets.name: Phosphor Riser Sweep
presets.sonicGoal: A tempo-locked riser where the EQ band-pass sweep is visually and sonically married to the beam's rotation/zoom motion.

presets.name: Rezz Void Drone
presets.sonicGoal: A mid-forward, unsettling drone that stays clean and readable under a four-on-the-floor kick; warmth kept in the sparse intro, mud and glare auto-clamped when the beat drops.

presets.name: Talkbox Butterfly (Vowel Morph)
presets.sonicGoal: Turn the buzz-source geometry into a vowel-morphing 'talking' lead that sweeps ah->ee under a mod source.

presets.name: Vox Machina — AH→EE Talkbeam
presets.styleRef: Daft Punk / Zapp talkbox, Rezz vocal-drone
presets.sonicGoal: A droning oscilloscope tone that literally speaks vowels as you turn MORPH — a robotic talkbox with no vocoder and no automation on the EQ.

presets.name: Beam-Mono Sub / Halo Wide
presets.styleRef: Modern EDM master-bus width (mono bass, wide air)
presets.sonicGoal: Rock-solid mono low-beam plus a wide, airy top — mono-compatible width.

presets.name: Five Vowels Rack — EE default
presets.sonicGoal: Drop a sung-vowel character onto ANY patch; ships bright EE, with the full A/E/I/O/U table in notes.

presets.name: Ice-Pick Tamer
presets.styleRef: Harsh-FM / metal high-mid taming (FabFilter spectral-dynamics style)
presets.sonicGoal: Kill wavefolder and high-harmonic screech dynamically — transparent when the sound is clean, clamps only on the harsh peaks.

presets.name: PSTN Transmission (Telephone)
presets.sonicGoal: Instantly collapse any patch into a 300Hz-3.4kHz landline-radio version for intros and pre-drop transitions, then snap back to full range.

presets.name: Pink-Slope Tilt (Warm / Bright)
presets.sonicGoal: Nudge any osc-FM patch toward a ~4.5 dB/oct perceptual balance in a single gesture.

presets.name: Pultec Sub-Anchor
presets.sonicGoal: Make a cube/torus sub-drone big AND tight - shelf weight in, mud scooped just above, plus a whisper of analog sheen.

presets.name: Soothe-Scope De-Harsh Bank
presets.sonicGoal: A layerable band set you drop onto ANY harsh Type 465 generator patch to tame ringing inharmonic partials without dulling the tone; the flagship droppable bank.

presets.name: Tilt Glue Master
presets.styleRef: Mastering-glue / one-move darken-or-brighten on the OsciSynth bus
presets.sonicGoal: A single spectral-tilt move to make any harmonically-dense Type 465 patch 'sit', preserving internal tonal relationships while taming the buzzy top.

presets.name: Vocal Pocket Unmask
presets.sonicGoal: Let a lead vocal or lead synth sit on top of the drone without turning the pad down — the pad stays full when the lead rests.

presets.name: Abandoned Relay
presets.sonicGoal: Surveillance radio-room bed with band-pass window and formant bells

presets.name: Abyss Watch
presets.sonicGoal: Deep slow-rotating abyssal drone bed with dark top

presets.name: Cathedral Brass
presets.sonicGoal: Big expensive cathedral brass bed with dynamic bark control

presets.name: Cinema Snarl
presets.sonicGoal: Aggressive talking-mid brostep with surgical harshness control

presets.name: Cold Sink Downer
presets.sonicGoal: Automated descending downer with dark top and dynamic harshness catch

presets.name: Crater Impact Tail
presets.sonicGoal: Impact drop-tail with fast dynamic top control and long release

presets.name: Dark Spiral Lead-Bass
presets.sonicGoal: Dark centered lead-bass with de-ringing and dark tilt

presets.name: Diesel Gargle
presets.sonicGoal: Chewy diesel growl bass with heavy drive and mid bark

presets.name: Event Horizon Riser
presets.sonicGoal: Performed tension riser with upper-mid build and upward air

presets.name: Festival Bloom Bass
presets.sonicGoal: Festival-forward punchy bright bass with snappy presence

presets.name: Glass Bloom
presets.sonicGoal: Airy hyper-detailed glossy bass with upward detail recovery

presets.name: Halo Bloom Pad
presets.sonicGoal: Smooth glowing halo pad with air shelf and gentle de-harsh

presets.name: Hollow Neon Pad-Bass
presets.sonicGoal: Hollowed low-mid pad-bass with glossy air shelf

presets.name: Hypno Spine
presets.sonicGoal: Hypnotic dark grinding mid-loop bass, monolithic and nasal

presets.name: Skyline Growl
presets.sonicGoal: Animated festival growl bass with upper-mid bite

presets.name: Swamp Hydraulic
presets.sonicGoal: Filthy low-mid-forward swamp bass with barked presence

presets.name: Yoi Throat Split
presets.sonicGoal: Moving-formant vocal-growl bass with narrow dynamic de-harsh

presets.name: Broken Tape Fog
presets.sonicGoal: Lo-fi ambient bed curve with dark shelves and slow upward whisper

presets.name: Brostep Control
presets.sonicGoal: Formant-paired brostep control curve with bright tilt

presets.name: Filth Weight
presets.sonicGoal: Weighty filthy bass curve with dark tilt and de-harsh

presets.name: Future-Detail Polish
presets.sonicGoal: Future-bass polish curve with wide presence lift and air

presets.name: Mainstage Lift
presets.sonicGoal: Festival smile-curve lift with excitement shelf and de-harsh

presets.name: Midnight Tunnel
presets.sonicGoal: Dark hypnotic tunnel curve with suppressed air

presets.name: Trailer Void Smile
presets.sonicGoal: Epic wide-and-deep trailer smile curve with mid trench
